changelog: Rebrand the native Android app to MAXCODE and the terminal to MAXTERM.
Add OpenCode Zen, xAI Grok, OpenRouter, and custom OpenAI-compatible chat providers.
Encrypt provider API keys at rest with Android Keystore; keys are not bundled in the APK.
Persist provider-aware chat history and retain official Gemini developer API access.
Refresh native chat surfaces with translucent liquid-glass styling.
